verdict.rationale: Xero offers some automated background processes—JAX auto-categorizing/matching bank transactions, AI-driven bill data extraction, duplicate bill detection—but these are narrow, feature-specific automations requiring human approval (e.g., 'draft bills ready for approval'), not a general-purpose automation/workflow builder that a user can configure to run autonomously. The MCP server and API/SDK enable external agents to call Xero, but that's developer integration, not an in-product autonomous automation setup for end users. Missing for 10: a documented in-app automation/rules engine for arbitrary autonomous workflows, evidence of fully unattended execution without human review, and independent confirmation these run reliably in the background.
